name: s81sl_xrt3q-s81sl_xrt3_b-COMMIT
purpose: S81 slice u_xr successor ot_s81sl_xrt3 (FB): replaces the old xr1/xr3 (functional gap: FFN result transport). Slice parents k8c-f (claude/s81-slicep-k8c-1021) instantiate ot_s81sl_xrt3.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_xrt3 #(.FOREG(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_S81SL_XR_PDC --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_xrt.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: s81sl_xrt3_b_muthops
bench.cmd: XR_PDC=1 XR_FOREG=1 bash tools/s81_slice/xrt_bench.sh {RUN}/s81sl_xrt3_b_muthops hops 1 1 6000 raw

bench.name: s81sl_xrt3_b_mutbwide
bench.cmd: XR_PDC=1 XR_FOREG=1 bash tools/s81_slice/xrt_bench.sh {RUN}/s81sl_xrt3_b_mutbwide bwide 1 1 6000 raw

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.06 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xrt3q/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xrt3q/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_xrt3q --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_xrt3  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
